method.rights: Use four pinned U.S. State Department archival TEI volumes under the repository's public-domain and CC0 dedication. Include direct body paragraphs only from U.S. official sender headings and omit embedded quoted, foreign and editorial material.
method.source_sampling: Hash order within each volume. Register up to 72 six-paragraph source windows per volume. Split up to four distinct official sender groups per volume into in-index evaluation and three into open-set holdout. Keep publisher corrections in a separate source group stratum.
method.text_retrieval: Index case-folded eight-word fingerprints with source positions. Suppress grams common to more than four archive documents. Require at least 20 supported words and 55% lexical support per paragraph, three strictly ordered body paragraphs and 65% whole-body support. Refuse competing source matches within 10 percentage points. Require 60 total supported words.
method.alignment: Retain strongly matched paragraphs and a single anchored gap between consecutive known anchors. Equal gaps can bind one changed paragraph. Unequal single gaps can identify an inserted or deleted paragraph. Leave exterior and longer ambiguous gaps unaligned.
method.differences: Use the existing exact word-and-punctuation comparison on each aligned paragraph. Report original decoded Unicode ranges and precise changed tokens. Combine each paragraph's changed-token runs into an envelope for overlap measurement, retaining the exact separate runs.
method.controls: Unchanged archive excerpts, exact same-source human sentence swaps, pre-correction publisher excerpts, a missing-source condition, quotes from a registered work inside unrelated genuine body text, and exact duplicate-source ambiguity. Generation adds no authorship label to the archive method.
method.publisher_probe: Separately include one identified three-paragraph excerpt around an actual U.S. archive typo correction, d585 in frus1964-68v24. Keep the six-paragraph pre-correction intake and its observed dispositions.
method.current: Measure first six incumbent native context windows at a raw response at least .5 on registered English original, ordinary sentence swap and generated files only. This is a location comparator.
method.metric: Useful query mismatch range requires .30 nonwhitespace character IoU and .50 recall with known replacement. Publisher corrections use independently measured exact query and reference character edit coordinates. Source availability and attribution, ordinary differences and false mismatches are distinct outcomes.
method.interpretation: This is a bounded public-source comparison. The result describes actual text matching or difference with the cited archive version. It contributes zero AI-origin or authorship confidence.
